newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran navy starts war games in Gulf of Oman.
newsitem.headline: Iran navy starts war games in Gulf of Oman.

text.p: Iran has launched four-day naval war games in the Gulf of Oman, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Monday.
It said the manoeuvres started on Sunday with amphibious operations in the Gulf of Oman, south of the oil-rich Gulf waterway's only entrance.

During the exercises, the navy forces will carry out patrol, rescue and diving operations, practice capturing coastal areas and destroying a hypothetical enemy's equipment and ammunition, the agency added.

Iran says its armed forces are strictly defensive. The Islamic republic opposes the military presence of the United States in the Gulf and says Washington falsely accuses Tehran of threatening regional security in order to scare its Gulf Arab allies into buying more U.S. arms.
